title: Master Admin panel

signIn.title: Panel sign-in
signIn.intro: For platform staff only. Staff of an institution sign in in the app.
signIn.failed: The email or password is not right.
signIn.notPlatform: This account is not a platform user.
signIn.step2Intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.wrongCode: This code is not right or has expired. Try the new code.
signIn.enrollIntro: Every platform account needs a second step. Add this key to an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the code it shows.
signIn.codeHelp: From your authenticator app (changes every 30 seconds).

newDevice: You signed in from a new device. Every Master Admin was told.

institutionTabs.title: Each institution will have these tabs

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.circuitAlert: Connection {{label}}{{name}} stopped after repeated failures ({{code}}); the backup is used for 5 minutes
dashboard.contractAlert: Daily check of the {{provider}} adapter failed
dashboard.emailPausedAlert: Email paused for {{name}}: {{bounced}} bounces, {{complained}} complaints of {{sent}} in 7 days

users.title: Platform users
users.intro: One person per account. Invite by email; the invite becomes active when that person signs in to the panel with the second step.
users.setupRights: Setup rights (enter an institution to help set it up)
users.reason: Reason (kept in the platform audit log)

roleHelp.developer: Developer inbox and error reports only.

noAccess: Your platform role does not include this page.

profiles.intro: Industry packs and type profiles are data: change them here without a new release. Edit a new version, check it, then publish it. A published version never changes; new versions are used by institutions set up after publishing.
profiles.signupHelp: Only open industries appear in the sign-up wizard. While only one is open, the wizard hides the industry step.
profiles.publishBody: Institutions set up from now on get this version. Institutions already set up keep theirs. A published version cannot be changed.
profiles.discardBody: The draft is removed. Published versions stay.
profiles.editorHelp: Change the name below, or anything in the JSON. Check it, then save the draft and publish it.

institutions.intro: Every institution with its industry and types. Open one for its words (Labels tab); approval, status and the other tabs come with 0B.07.

labelsTab.title: Words of this institution
labelsTab.help: Where each word comes from. Lock a word that must not change (for example the legal receipt title); a locked word is read-only for the institution.
labelsTab.lockHelp: The institution will not be able to change this word. The reason is kept in both audit logs.
labelsTab.unlockHelp: The institution will be able to change this word again.

productLabels.title: Product words
productLabels.intro: The neutral words under every industry pack, used when a pack has no word for a key. Changing them never changes a word an institution set itself.

plan.newerVersion: Version {{version}} of this plan exists; choose it to move
plan.fitTitle: Before moving to this plan, reduce:
plan.price: Price for this institution (empty = the plan's price)
plan.overridesHelp: For example {"users": 40, "sms_month": 5000}; null = unlimited; leave out to use the plan's limit.
plan.modulesHelp: Allow a module beyond the plan, take one away, or follow the plan.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Modules, limits, prices (also per institution type) and trial length of each plan. Saving makes a new version; institutions keep theirs until they change plan. The numbers are placeholders until set.

overview.trialFlag: Many open trials: {{person}} by this person, {{phone}} with this phone (limit {{limit}}).
overview.exportsHelp: Every row of the institution, its people and a list of its files. Closing needs an export from the last 7 days.
overview.webOnly: Open the panel on the web to download the file.
overview.reason: Reason (kept in the history and both audit logs)
overview.needsExport: Make a full export first (Full exports below).

explain.trial: The institution is approved; its trial starts now.
explain.read_only: People can see and export everything but change nothing. Nothing is deleted.
explain.suspended: Nobody can open this institution until it is reactivated; people's other institutions are not affected.
explain.closed: The institution is closed now and its data is deleted after the notice period. This cannot be undone.

overview.enterHelp: Read only, for the time you choose. The institution sees who entered, when and why.

create.title: Create institution
create.intro: The same wizard as self sign-up. The trial starts at once and the Super Admin gets an invitation.
create.adminHelp: The Super Admin is invited by email. Someone who already has a login joins at once; otherwise they join when they first sign in with this email.
create.attached: Created. The Super Admin already had a login and has joined.
create.invited: Created. {{email}} joins when they sign in with this email.

copy.title: Copy setup into {{name}}
copy.help: Copies configuration only (words, settings, custom fields) from another institution; never its records. What this institution already has is kept.

integrations.title: Connections
integrations.help: SMS, email and other services of this institution. Keys are write-only: only a hint is ever shown.
integrations.label: Name
integrations.liveUntested: live test needed before bulk sending
integrations.secretsHelp: Write-only: the key goes straight to the vault and is never shown again. A future date schedules a rotation; the current key works until then.
integrations.secretSaved: Key saved; only its hint is kept for display.
integrations.payersHelp: Direct: the institution's own account. Platform: the platform's gateway, billed to the institution.

actions.email.not_queued: A platform mail could not be queued

integrations.testHelp: A phone number or email address; the message goes through this connection only.
integrations.testQueued: Test queued; see the delivery log.
integrations.primaryDone: This is now the primary connection; queued messages use it at once.
integrations.fallbackHelp: When all of the institution's own connections fail, the platform gateway sends instead (billed to the institution).
integrations.fallbackLabel: {{kind}}: use the platform gateway as the last backup

providers.intro: The provider catalog and the platform's own gateways, used when the platform pays or an institution has none.
providers.platformHelp: The default SMS gateway and mail of the platform.

delivery.intro: Every send result and the daily usage per institution. Only platform-paid usage is billable.

email.title: Email
email.help: Sending domains and the sender identity. Every institution sends from its own verified domain or its own address on the platform mail; one institution's bounces never affect another.
email.paused: Email is paused since {{date}}: {{reason}}. Sign-in codes still go.
email.resumeReason: Why it can resume (e.g. list cleaned)
email.reputation: Last 7 days: {{sent}} sent, {{delivered}} delivered, {{bounced}} bounced, {{complained}} spam complaints
email.noPlatformSender: No platform mail address yet (verify a domain or set the platform mail domain).
email.verifyFailed: Could not check now; try again in a minute.
email.domainHelp: e.g. ideal.edu.bd — add the records below at the domain's DNS, then Verify.
